subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should `openclaw agents set-identity --identity-file` reject existing identity files above the shared 2 MiB workspace-bootstrap limit rather than preserving its formerly unbounded import behavior?
rationale: The code makes a defensible OOM-hardening choice, but it intentionally changes an existing CLI input contract for valid large files; source review cannot determine the acceptable compatibility policy.

options.title: Keep the shared 2 MiB cap
options.body: Accept the bounded explicit-import behavior, retain the clear error, and require final-head CLI evidence before merge.

options.title: Preserve uncapped explicit imports
options.body: Restore the prior import behavior if large explicit files are a supported compatibility contract, accepting that this leaves the unbounded-read exposure on that path.

recommendation.title: Keep the shared 2 MiB cap
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded explicit-import behavior, retain the clear error, and require final-head CLI evidence before merge.
